summary: ParaZero Technologies Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on August 3, 2026, announcing a press release regarding an initial order for its DefendAir Net Pods from a Tier-1 European defense manufacturer. The order supports integration of net-based interception technology into an autonomous Counter-UAS system. No financial terms, pricing, or transaction structure were disclosed. The filing is a routine business development announcement, not a special-situation corporate event. The registrant is neither acquiring nor divesting assets, nor engaging in capital transactions or strategic restructuring. This is an ordinary operational update for a foreign private issuer.
